raw.keyword: do i need thailand digital arrival card

items.markdown:
Yes, you do. `All foreign nationals entering Thailand (whether by air, land, or sea) are required to submit the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) within 3 days before their arrival`.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)

You must complete this form regardless of your visa status (including visa exemptions). The only exceptions are passengers transiting through the airport without passing through immigration and those entering with a Border Pass.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23) [[1]](https://thailandinsider.com/plan-your-trip/)

To submit your details, use the official [Thai Immigration Bureau TDAC System](https://tdac.immigration.go.th/) and make sure to save or screenshot the generated QR code to present to immigration officers upon arrival.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/holidays-thailand/travel-advice)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/content/thailand-digital-arrival-card-tdac-required-from-1?page=5d6636cd15e39c3bd00072da)
